name: Suma app
summary: Prototype test App (compiled MATLAB) that adds 1 to the parameter n1 and saves the sum to a .mat file; the T1w input is not used.
description: Course or prototype App for testing brainlife MATLAB packaging. It reads n1 from config.json, computes 1 + n1 and writes out_dir/suma.mat. It does no image processing and should not be used for analysis.

inputs.description: T1-weighted image (required by the registration but not read by the code).
